title: 19 non-negotiable demands to change the Dark Skies pilot, and NBC's Don Ohlmeyer steps in
summary: Bryce Zabel tells of 19 non-negotiable demands to change the Dark Skies pilot, and NBC's Don Ohlmeyer steps in, about 1996 at Los Angeles, California, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: a list of 19 non-negotiable demands of things that had to change in our pilot.

plain: Bryce Zabel, a television writer and producer, says that in 1996 in Los Angeles, his first episode of Dark Skies, a TV series about a hidden UFO history, came back from the network with a list of 19 non-negotiable demands for changes. He tells this on Jesse Michels's podcast and names his co-creator Brent Friedman, Steven Spielberg, and Don Ohlmeyer, an executive at the NBC network who, by his account, stepped in personally. He tells it as an example of how much attention the powerful paid to UFO stories on screen.
